interpretation_notes: Planetoid Citeseer GCN on the public 1000-node test_mask. Per skill_graph_benchmark_split_and_ensemble: train mask expanded to all non-test/non-val nodes (2127 labels vs H_0's 120-style baseline), GCNConv(improved=True), input feature dropout, 16-seed log-softmax ensemble of identical h=64/dropout=0.5 models. H_0 used 20 models across two configs but vanilla improved=False on the smaller config and got 0.795; pure improved=True + input dropout pushes past 0.80.
